positions.title: Member of the Technical Staff
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · On-site

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Backend Software Engineer in the Identity & Access Management team within the Central Security org. In charge of the services and libraries which power authentication, authorization and access management across Meta's infrastructure and FoA. Maintain and build core security systems and libraries which serve over 60 billion access checks per second. 

Currently focused on evolving the company's IAM capabilities to solve the novel challenges (risk, friction, new use case enablement) associated with AI Agents.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Worked on the Real Time Infrastructure team in the extension of an internal network transport and framing library. Focused on streaming and Rpc service interfaces.
- Implementation of code generation service for client and server side RPC applications. 
- Implemented a new client/server interface for streaming applications. 
- Reduced the effort required to build the network communication part of internal applications. 
- Development done in C++

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Worked on the Hyperledger initiative as a Software Engineer focused on Applied Cryptography. Development done in C++ with usage of Libsnark and Sodium cryptographic libraries

honors.title: Winner of the MIT Bitcoin Hackathon
honors.description:
Winner of the Applied Cryptography prize @ MIT Bitcoin Hackathon 
Developed "ProxyChat"  a decentralized, end-to-end encrypted group chatting application, implemented using proxy re-encryption.
Team member was Omar Sagga (BU 19').
honors.issuer: Issued by Massachusetts Institute of Technology · Mar 2018

projects.title: Veterinarian Finder
projects.description: Developed iOS mobile application for vetexplore.com in Swift. Knowledge of NSData, CoreLocation, and Web API Development. The application can be found in the Apple AppStore under the name "Veterinarian Finder" published by Pure Digital
